cards.title: Avoid duplicate-product free gifts
cards.claim: The passage argues that giving more of the same subscription product as a free gift can leave customers with excess inventory and may prompt them to delay or cancel a future order.
cards.action: Do not use more of the same subscribed product as the free gift; communicate the gift to subscribers when it is upcoming.
applies_when: A subscriber is scheduled to receive a free gift
The gift would duplicate the recurring product
unknowns: Whether this effect varies by product category, consumption rate, or gift size
evidence_quotes: "I don't want you to give more of the same product as a part of the free gift."
"I'm probably going to delay or cancel my next order with you because I have too much."
"there is no point of having these gifts if you don't communicate this."

cards.title: Billing reminders can foreground benefits and delay options
cards.claim: In an example A/B test described in the passage, changing a billing reminder from a standard transactional format to one with education, benefits, perks, and a delay option was reported to reduce cancellation rate from 8.6% to 5.8%.
cards.action: In billing reminders, highlight product benefits and subscriber perks, offer a one-click delay option, and place the manage-subscription option lower in the email.
applies_when: Customers may need more time before their next shipment
unknowns: A/B-test design, sample size, duration, and statistical significance
Whether the reported result transfers to other brands or products
How the one-click delay links were implemented
evidence_quotes: "we were able to actually get a 33% decrease in cancellations with just a couple simple changes going from 8.6% to 5.8%."
"That is by changing this billing reminder to have proper education and highlight all the benefits that they're getting."
"The next part of a billy reminder that we want is we want to push people to delay their order."
"all the way at the bottom. Then do we have the need to adjust your subscription manage my subscription button"

cards.title: Customize transactional messages by subscription stage
cards.claim: The passage recommends varying billing reminders and order confirmations by subscribed product and rebill/order number, including upcoming gifts where applicable.
cards.action: Customize billing reminders and order confirmations based on the subscribed product, whether the order is subscription versus one-time, and the subscription order number; include an upcoming free gift when applicable.
applies_when: Different rebill stages or products have different customer contexts
A specific subscription order includes a free gift
unknowns: Which message variations have the strongest effect at each order number
Whether platform capabilities support all stated segmentation
The performance impact outside the cited examples
